name: Beeblebum
noteEs: Creator alemán con audiencia internacional, especializado en base building y construcción inteligente en NMS y otros sandbox espaciales (Space Engineers, Windrose). Sus tutoriales explican técnicas avanzadas — glitches de building, layouts eficientes, mods de building — con calidad de producción alta y demo step-by-step. Operates servidores comunitarios donde la audiencia construye en paralelo.
noteEn: Berlin-based creator with international audience, specialized in base building and smart construction in NMS and other space sandboxes (Space Engineers, Windrose). His tutorials explain advanced techniques — building glitches, efficient layouts, building mods — with high production quality and step-by-step demos. Runs community servers where the audience builds along.
highlightsEs: Tutoriales de base building con técnicas avanzadas y glitches
Servidores multiplayer comunitarios para builds colaborativas
Cobertura rotativa entre NMS, Space Engineers y otros sandbox
Producción visual cuidada y narración clara
highlightsEn: Base-building tutorials with advanced techniques and glitches
Community multiplayer servers for collaborative builds
Rotating coverage between NMS, Space Engineers and other sandboxes
